summarization:
This smartphone UI screen is primarily a notifications page. The main contents and functions of this screen are as follows:

1. **Title Bar**: At the top, there is a title bar with the text "सूचनाएं" (Notifications) indicating that this screen is for viewing notifications.
2. **Settings Icon**: On the right side of the title bar, there is a gear icon, which likely provides access to notification settings.
3. **Back Arrow**: On the left side of the title bar, there is a back arrow icon, which allows the user to navigate back to the previous screen.
4. **Main Content Area**: The central part of the screen displays the message "कोई नयी सूचनाएं नहीं हैं" (There are no new notifications), indicating that there are currently no new notifications for the user.

The overall design is simple and clean, focusing on informing the user about the status of their notifications.
